title: Nichole Therapy
description:
You decide to see a new therapist to treat some personal issues… and are surprised to find out your therapist is a striking young woman, but she is warm, friendly, and passionate about helping patients get better.
There’s no reason to discount the role attractiveness plays in helping you trust your therapist, so I use that to my advantage. I truly believe unlocking your repressed sexuality will open you up to life’s new experiences and remove the blocks that are making you unhappy.
And I’d like to start diving into all this right here, in my office. I know it’s an unorthodox practice and it’s hard to relax while doing something so “inappropriate”, but that’s why I have a special tool to instantly get you to comply.
By the end, you might not remember all of my treatment methods, but you will remember how effective they are.
*Note: this is a role-play fantasy and not a substitute for professional medical advice.
author: Goddess Nichole
